issues.explanation: The unique-violation mapper is copy-pasted in two actions instead of being reused.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes in app/Actions/* with Gate authorization inside actions (CreateQueue.php:58, UpdateQueue.php:216, SetQueueAccess.php:151); QueuePolicy for all abilities; migration with reversible down() (2026_10_29_053156_create_queue_access_table.php:13-16); QueueAccess uses HasFactory + #[Fillable] + casts() matching Ticket style; audit logging via Log::channel('audit'); docs + CHANGELOG updated in same diff

readability.evidence: Clear names (slugTakenByOther, manageAccess, SetQueueAccess), small focused methods, consistent early-throw style; no dead code or debug output in change.diff

requirements.evidence: CreateQueue.php:56-88 trims name, slugifies default/explicit slug, enforces 1-255, per-entity unique + QueryException->ValidationException, is_active true; UpdateQueue.php:214-270 nullable named params, keeps own slug via whereKeyNot, cross-entity slugs allowed; SetQueueAccess.php:144-191 cross-entity ValidationException, tryFrom validation, upsert/delete + audit with actor_id/queue_id/entity_membership_id and no log on empty revoke; QueuePolicy.php:449-500 create/update/manageAccess/call incl. corrupted non-array deny; CallNextTicket.php:29 Gate after active check; Ticket.php:404-424 lock, inactive check, Gate authorize, then waiting check; docs/CHANGELOG updated

scope.evidence: All hunks serve the task: 3 actions, enum, model, factory, migration, policy, 2 call-path enforcements, docs/CHANGELOG, 4 test files + CallNextTicketTest owner setup; no delete action, no UI, no unrelated refactors

security.evidence: Gate::forUser authorize on every write/call path (CreateQueue.php:58, UpdateQueue.php:216, SetQueueAccess.php:151, CallNextTicket.php:29, Ticket.php:418); input validated (name/slug length, slugified, permissions tryFrom + is_string); QueueAccess #[Fillable] allowlist; policy call denies non-members and corrupted non-array via is_array check

simplicity.evidence: Lean overall and reuses Str::slug, Gate, membershipFor, updateOrCreate; but isUniqueViolation() is duplicated verbatim in app/Actions/CreateQueue.php:108-118 and app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:282-292 (plus near-duplicate slugTaken/slugTakenByOther)

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Queue/CreateQueueTest.php, UpdateQueueTest.php, SetQueueAccessTest.php, QueuePolicyTest.php cover happy paths, ValidationException (blank/overlong/duplicate/cross-entity/unknown permissions), AuthorizationException (employee/outsider/stranger/self-grant), audit grant/revoke incl. no-log case, corrupted permissions, every CallMode, Ticket::call inactive-before-auth and already-called cases; CallNextTicketTest adds owner membership to preserve coverage

review.summary: Implements the full queue domain slice — lifecycle actions, queue_access grants with audit logging, QueuePolicy, and call enforcement on both paths — with comprehensive Pest coverage. Scores reflect complete requirements, conventions, and security; the only nit is the duplicated unique-violation helper, so approve with nits.
